issue.title: 96 vault files sync to Obsidian but are untracked in the vault Git repo
issue.description:
96 files totalling 23.9 MB live on the Obsidian Sync remote but are not tracked
in the vault Git repo (`git@github.com:bobs-org/bob.git`), so Obsidian Sync is
their only off-machine copy. Epic bob-cli-1e proved that is not a safe place to
leave data: excluding a folder from Sync, or rebuilding the remote vault, drops
every remote-only file.

Breakdown by extension (2026-08-27, from the sync client's `server_files` state
DB diffed against `git -C ~/bob ls-files`):

| ext | files | size |
| --- | ----- | ---- |
| `.zot` | 22 | 0.01 MB |
| `.tsv` | 21 | 11.24 MB |
| `.xmind` | 20 | 4.14 MB |
| `.json` | 7 | 3.04 MB |
| `.pyc` | 6 | 0.15 MB |
| `.py` | 6 | 0.17 MB |
| `.js` | 6 | 1.31 MB |
| `.css` | 3 | 0.05 MB |
| `.txt` | 2 | 1.24 MB |
| `.puml`, `.md`, `.png` | 3 | 2.51 MB |

Largest: `_meta/migration/inventory.json` (3.04 MB) and the
`_meta/migration/reports/*.tsv` set (~10 MB).

Root cause: `~/bob/.gitignore` ignores `*` and re-includes a fixed extension
allowlist (`!*.md`, `!*.pdf`, `!*.png`, ...). Every extension above is missing
from that allowlist. Some exclusions are deliberate and must stay — the
`.obsidian/plugins/bob-*/main.js` files are sourced from the bob-plugins repo,
and `.pyc` is build output — so this needs a per-extension decision, not a
blanket `!*`.

Related precedent: epic phase bob-cli-1e.1 fixed exactly this class of gap for
`old_lib/gov/2024_tax_return.PDF`, whose uppercase `.PDF` extension fell through
the case-sensitive `!*.pdf` re-include (vault commit ac31423).

Proposed by bob-cli-1e.5 (epic bob-cli-1e, Remove old_lib from Obsidian Sync and
restore the vault under quota) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2.

task_type_fields.impact: Obsidian Sync is the only off-machine copy for 23.9 MB of vault content, including the _meta/migration reports and every .xmind mind map. Any Sync exclusion, remote-vault rebuild, or account loss destroys them, and epic bob-cli-1e showed all three are live scenarios.
task_type_fields.repro:
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json, subprocess
D='/home/bryan/.config/obsidian-headless/sync/8a259ad922718b6d8400c1f0e3ba8abe/state.db'
remote={p:json.loads(d).get('size',0) for p,d in
        sqlite3.connect(D).execute('select path, data from server_files')
        if not (json.loads(d).get('folder') or json.loads(d).get('deleted'))}
tracked=set(subprocess.run(['git','-C','/home/bryan/bob','ls-files'],
                           capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines())
missing={p:s for p,s in remote.items() if p not in tracked}
print(len(missing), 'files', sum(missing.values())/1e6, 'MB')
PY
# 2026-08-27: 96 files 23.9 MB
```

payload.description: Same durability concern from the other direction: 1g covers vault files Git ignores by extension, 1k covers vault files Git cannot hold at all. A single off-site-backup decision could resolve both.

evidence.note: Reproduced today at 2026-08-27 ~17:30 EDT on athena, and the impact is now strictly worse than when this was filed. Re-ran the measurement against the live vault after epic bob-cli-1n cut over: `git -C ~/bob ls-files -o -i --exclude-standard`, filtered to remove the deliberate policy exclusions (lit_review/, xlib/, .obsidian/plugins/bob-*, .sase/, .trash/, machine-local Obsidian state, the two over-100-MiB old_lib PDFs, and editor/OS junk), still returns 86 real vault content files. The same extension classes named in the description are intact: 22 _zorg_templates/zot/*.zot, 20 xmind/*.xmind, 23 _meta/migration/reports/*.tsv, _meta/migration/inventory.json, 6 _meta/migration/tools/*.py, gkeep_gdocs_inbox_dump.txt, needs_attn_notes.txt, puml/3b_ts.puml, and lib/docs/gastown_readme.textbundle/{info.json,text.markdown}. ~/bob/.gitignore still uses the ignore-everything-then-allowlist pattern and none of .zot, .xmind, .tsv, .py, .puml, .markdown, or non-.obsidian .json are in the allowlist. ESCALATION: the description says 'Obsidian Sync is their only off-machine copy'. As of bob-cli-1n's cutover those files now have NO off-machine copy at all -- ob-sync-bob.service is disabled and inactive and the Obsidian Sync core plugin is off in the vault config, while git still ignores every one of these paths. They also no longer propagate between athena and the MacBook, so the two machines can silently diverge on them. bob-cli-1n's reconcile phase committed a 206-path backlog but did not widen the allowlist, so the underlying gap is untouched. Reported by bob-cli-1n.land during the bob-cli-1n landing.
